players.bio: Alexander Sean Pablo Robertson (born 17 April 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL Championship club Cardiff City. Born in Scotland, he represented both Australia and England at youth international level, before making his senior debut for Australia in March 2023.
Brian Barry-Murphy (born 27 July 1978) is an Irish professional football manager and former player who is the head coach of EFL League One club Cardiff City.

Callum Jack Robinson (born 2 February 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship side Cardiff City. Robinson represents the Republic of Ireland national team. Robinson is a product of the Aston Villa academy. Robinson twice played for Preston on loan from Aston Villa before joining on a permanent deal in 2016.

Calum Chambers (born 20 January 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or right-back and captains for EFL Championship club Cardiff City. Originally a member of Southampton's academy system, Chambers was promoted to the first team at the beginning of the 2012–13 campaign. After two seasons with the club, he moved to fellow Premier League club Arsenal.

Calum Alexander Scanlon is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Cardiff City, on loan from Premier League club Liverpool. He has represented England at international youth level.
Christopher Anthony Willock (born 31 January 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Cardiff City.
Cian Ty Ashford is a Welsh footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Cardiff City. He is a Wales Under-21 international.

David Turnbull (born 10 July 1999) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Cardiff City and the Scotland national team. He began his career at Motherwell before moving to Celtic in 2020 where he won the three Scottish domestic competitions twice each; he also won both the major Young Player of the Year awards (SFWA with Motherwell and PFA with Celtic).
Dylan Rhys Lawlor (born 1 January 2006) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Cardiff City and the Wales national team.

Gabriel Jeremiah Adedayo Osho (born 14 August 1998) is a professional footballer who plays for EFL Championship club Cardiff City. Mainly a centre-back, Osho can be deployed as a full-back. Born in England, he represents the Nigeria national team. Early life and education Born in Reading, Osho attended The Forest School in Winnersh.
Harry Alfred Tyrer (born 6 December 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Cardiff City.
Isaak James Davies (born 25 September 2001) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Cardiff City. He is a former Wales Under-21 international.
Jack Moylan (born 1 September 2001) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or left winger for EFL Championship club Cardiff City and the Republic of Ireland.
Joel Matthew Bagan (born 3 September 2001) is a professional footballer who plays for EFL Championship club Cardiff City. He is a former Republic of Ireland under-21 international.
Joel William Colwill (born 27 October 2004) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Cardiff City and the Wales national team.
Luey Philip Giles is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a defender for National League club Kidderminster Harriers on loan from EFL Championship club Cardiff City.
Matthew David Turner (born 27 March 2002) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Cardiff City.

Nathan Wallace Newman Trott (born 21 November 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Cardiff City on loan from Danish Superliga club Copenhagen. Born in Bermuda, he has represented both Bermuda and England at youth international level.
Oliver Anthony Tanner (born 13 May 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Cardiff City.

Perry Tian Hee Ng (born 24 June 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays either as a full-back or centre-back for EFL Championship club Cardiff City. He made his professional debut for Crewe Alexandra in 2015, after a loan at Hyde United, and made over 150 appearances for Crewe before joining Cardiff in January 2021.
Ronan Sahr Kpakio (born 25 May 2007) is a Welsh footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Cardiff City and the Wales national team.
Rubin James Colwill (born 27 April 2002) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Welsh club Cardiff City and the Wales national team.

William Thomas Fish (born 17 February 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Cardiff City. A graduate of Manchester United's youth system, Fish made his first-team debut for the club in a Premier League game in May 2021. He had a loan spell at Stockport County during the 2021–22 season, and was loaned twice to Hibernian.
Yousef Salech (born 17 January 2002) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Cardiff.
